adaptation: Official CPAModule and CPATrainingPlan.training_step. Bypass optional plot/tuner imports and logging-only batch R2. No task model/loss replacement.

runtime_compatibility.reason: RTX PRO6000 Blackwell requires modern CUDA kernels
runtime_compatibility.note: Runtime compatibility reproduction, not a bitwise reproduction of legacy dependency stack; existing TxPert environment is unchanged.

architecture.covariate_rationale: Native covariate-free configuration; background is encoded from observed target controls. No untrained held-cell-line embeddings.

losses.adversarial: official basal-latent perturbation classifier, cross entropy, reg_adv=1, pen_adv=1 gradient penalty, adv_steps=3

benchmark.expression: anchor2048_log1p_per10000_v1; no further normalization or gene selection
benchmark.validation: immutable four environment panels,448 response conditions and80 distribution conditions
benchmark.full_test: 1525 target conditions in held environment; distribution for every target

inference.input: observed target control cells, desired target index, dose1; no target perturbed cells
inference.output: 512 learned conditional Normal samples, mixed over empirical target control states
inference.transform: clamp_min(0) to satisfy nonnegative expression-cloud interface; censored Gaussian output, not NB/ZINB/counts
inference.cloud_mean: float64 accumulation of exported cloud, then float32; actual cloud equals reported mean
diagnostics: native unconstrained mean with separate response metrics
inference.joint_structure: Diagonal Gaussian conditional on the encoded control; joint covariance comes from the mixture over target-control states. No extra generator added.
inference.distribution_scope: native likelihood sampling with disclosed boundary transform, not default CPA.predict mean-only helper
inference.generation_seed: sha256(cpa-cloud-v1,run_seed,environment,target); fixed across checkpoints; independent local generator

selection.metric_geometry: fresh train-E-only gene scales floor .05, PCA32, KMeans8,128 unit projections seed29
selection.full_external_validation_after_selection: means1525; distribution32 preregistered external-panel targets; report only,no reselection
